principle: Create useful, transparent, distinct assets that can earn their own demand and citations; never create clones merely to occupy results.

blueprints.name_he: חדשות הבריאות של ד״ר גיא רופא
blueprints.audience: Hebrew readers who encountered a medical claim in Israeli news
workflow: Detect a high-attention Israeli health story
Preserve and link to the analyzed news article
Locate the primary study, official data or professional guidance
Explain what the headline gets right, what it omits and what remains uncertain
Add original non-populist analysis, clear numbers and practical context
Require human medical review before publication
